owner_intent: All UI rules, UI tools, UI fidelity gates and implementation language recommendations belong under Mechanicus.
Monoliths are forbidden as a normal development form, including backend monoliths.
Fast result is not the priority; working, maintainable, provable result is the priority.

owns: UI design tokens and component architecture rules

monolith_law: A monolith is forbidden unless explicitly registered as transitional debt.
A patch may not increase monolith debt unless its declared purpose is de-monolithization support or short-lived migration scaffolding.
UI must be split into tokens, layout, components, rooms, services/bridges, telemetry and assets.
Backend must be split by responsibility: commands, filesystem/repo discovery, receipts, validators, process execution, security policy.
Validators must not encourage monoliths by only checking markers in giant files.
No file may become a dumping ground because it is currently convenient.

reference_candidate_rules: Do not use a full screenshot bitmap as proof of a live UI.
Reference overlay modes are allowed only as visual aid and must be labelled NON_CANON_REFERENCE_AID.
Live DOM must visibly carry the target form in normal mode.
Invisible hit zones over a bitmap are forbidden as fidelity proof.

current_debt_policy: Existing APP_TAURI main.js/styles.css/main.rs are known transitional debt.
This patch records the law and the scanner; it does not fail the current repository for pre-existing monoliths.
Future UI work must either reduce monolith debt or be explicitly registered as temporary debt with Owner-visible rationale.
anti_fake_green: Build proof is not architecture proof.
A pretty screenshot is not maintainability proof.
Reference image overlay is not live UI proof.
Marker presence is not component architecture proof.
Line count alone is not truth, but a giant multi-responsibility file is a prosecution signal.
